name: K-1 Fiancé(e) Visa (Form I-129F)

phases.name: Document Collection
documents: U.S. passport or proof of citizenship (petitioner)
Proof of domicile in the U.S. (petitioner)
Divorce decree(s) or death certificate of former spouse (petitioner, if applicable)
Divorce decree(s) or death certificate of former spouse (beneficiary, if applicable)
Proof of relationship history (at least one in-person meeting within the last 2 years)
documents_pt: Passaporte americano ou comprovante de cidadania (peticionário)
Sentença(s) de divórcio ou certidão de óbito do ex-cônjuge (peticionário, se aplicável)
Sentença(s) de divórcio ou certidão de óbito do ex-cônjuge (beneficiário, se aplicável)
Provas do histórico do relacionamento (pelo menos um encontro presencial nos últimos 2 anos)
Certidão(ões) de antecedentes criminais (beneficiário, todos os países exigidos)
documents_es: Pasaporte estadounidense o comprobante de ciudadanía (peticionario)
Comprobante de domicilio en EE. UU. (peticionario)
Sentencia(s) de divorcio o acta de defunción del excónyuge (peticionario, si aplica)
Sentencia(s) de divorcio o acta de defunción del excónyuge (beneficiario, si aplica)
Pruebas del historial de la relación (al menos un encuentro en persona en los últimos 2 años)
Certificado(s) de antecedentes penales (beneficiario, todos los países requeridos)
steps: Confirm at least one in-person meeting within the required 2-year window (or exemption grounds)

phases.name: Case Preparation
steps: Confirm relationship is genuine and well documented
Confirm timeline is consistent across documents
Create, configure, and organize required online accounts (USCIS, CEAC, etc.)

phases.name: Execution
steps: Case received by National Visa Center (NVC)

phases.name: Finalization
steps: Entry instructions explained (90-day window to marry)
Post-entry marriage and Adjustment of Status guidance provided

pricing.notes: No separate paper-filing tier -- Form I-129F is USCIS-filed once regardless of tier; Standard vs. Plus differs in scope of support (interview prep, RFE responses, printing/mailing, consular-stage guidance), not filing method.
pricing.source: Real Saes Professional Services contract (Downloads/Contratos, 'K1_VISA_CONTRACT_ENG.pdf'), extracted 2026-08-02.

standard_includes: Final package delivered by email (client prints and mails)
standard_excludes: Use of the SAES card without a fee
Consular-stage support (CEAC, DS-160, NVC upload, etc.)
plus_includes: Complete Form I-129F preparation and filing
RFE/NOID response at no additional cost
Interview preparation for petitioner and beneficiary
Consular-stage guidance for the beneficiary (DS-160, financial evidence, appointment instructions)
standard_includes_pt: Pacote final entregue por e-mail (cliente imprime e envia)
standard_includes_es: Paquete final entregado por correo electrónico (el cliente imprime y envía)
standard_excludes_pt: Uso do cartão SAES sem taxa
Suporte na fase consular (CEAC, DS-160, upload no NVC, etc.)
standard_excludes_es: Uso de la tarjeta SAES sin tarifa
Soporte en la etapa consular (CEAC, DS-160, carga en NVC, etc.)
plus_includes_pt: Preparação e envio completo do Formulário I-129F
Resposta a RFE/NOID sem custo adicional
Preparação para entrevista do peticionário e do beneficiário
Orientação da fase consular ao beneficiário (DS-160, provas financeiras, instruções de agendamento)
plus_includes_es: Preparación y presentación completa del Formulario I-129F
Preparación de los documentos del peticionario
Respuesta a RFE/NOID sin costo adicional
Preparación para la entrevista del peticionario y del beneficiario
Orientación de la etapa consular para el beneficiario (DS-160, evidencia financiera, instrucciones de la cita)
